caption:
Is your savings account interest tax-free up to ₹10,000?

Only if you file under the old tax regime: the ₹10,000 deduction on savings interest isn't available in the new regime.
In the new regime, all your savings interest is added to your income, and banks usually don't deduct TDS on it, so report it in your ITR.
Seniors (60+) in the old regime get a larger deduction of up to ₹50,000, which also covers FD interest.
